title: Two Sum
prompt: Return indices of two numbers that add up to target. Exactly one solution. Prefer O(n) with a dict.
explanation: Store value→index while scanning; look for target-x.

title: Valid Anagram
prompt: Return True if t is an anagram of s.
explanation: Counters equal iff same character frequencies. Or sort both strings.

title: FizzBuzz

title: Max Subarray (Kadane)
explanation: Kadane: extend or restart at each element.

title: Reverse Words
prompt: Reverse word order; collapse spaces. '  hello   world  ' → 'world hello'.
explanation: str.split() with no args collapses whitespace and strips.
